title: GST Composition Scheme Overview
source: CBIC, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: The GST Composition Scheme is a simplified tax compliance scheme designed for small businesses and traders. Taxpayers with an aggregate annual turnover up to ₹1.5 crore (₹75 lakh for special category states) can opt for the Composition Scheme. Composition taxpayers pay GST at a lower flat rate on turnover: 1% for manufacturers and traders, 5% for restaurants, and 6% for service providers (up to ₹50 lakh turnover). Key restrictions: Composition taxpayers cannot issue Tax Invoices, cannot collect GST from customers, cannot claim Input Tax Credit (ITC), and cannot engage in interstate supplies or e-commerce sales.
